This program was written by Steve Simon on 2024-10-15 and is placed in the public domain.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(broom)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
#| label: create-artificial

g <- rep(c("A", "B", "C"), c(3, 5, 3))
y <- c(
  23, 30, 25, 
  33, 36, 41, 37, 43,
  24, 29, 31
)
xpos <- c(1:3, 6:10, 13:15)

data.frame(g, y, xpos) |>
  group_by(g) |>
  mutate(ybar=mean(y)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(ybarbar=mean(y)) |>
  mutate(sst=(y-ybarbar)^2) |>
  mutate(ssw=(y-ybar)^2) |>
  mutate(ssb=(ybar-ybarbar)^2) -> d

d

w=6 # plot width
h=4 # plot height
```

```{r}
#| label: plot01

ggplot(d) +
  aes(xpos, y, col=factor(g)) + 
  expand_limits(y=c(15,50), breaks=5**(3:10)) +
  scale_x_continuous(
      breaks=c(2, 8, 14), 
      minor=NULL,
      labels=c("A", "B", "C")) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks=seq(from=15, to=50, by=5),
    minor=NULL) +
  labs(
    caption="Simon, 2024-10-22",
    x=" ",
    y=" ") +
  theme(legend.position="none") -> plot00

plot00 + geom_text(label=y) -> plot01
plot01
ggsave("../images/plot01.png", width=w, height=h, units="in")
```

```{r}
#| label: plot02

plot01 +
  geom_segment(xend=d$xpos, yend=d$ybarbar) +
  geom_text(y=d$ybarbar, label=d$ybarbar) +
  geom_text(y=15, label=d$sst) -> plot02

plot02
ggsave("../images/plot02.png", width=w, height=h, units="in")
```
```{r}
#| label: plot03

plot01 +
  geom_segment(xend=d$xpos, yend=d$ybar) +
  geom_text(y=d$ybar, label=d$ybar) +
  geom_text(y=15, label=d$ssw) -> plot03

plot03
ggsave("../images/plot03.png", width=w, height=h, unit="in")
```

```{r}
#| label: plot04

plot00 +
  geom_text(y=d$ybar, label=d$ybar) +
  geom_segment(x=d$xpos, y=d$ybar, xend=d$xpos, yend=d$ybarbar) +
  geom_text(y=d$ybarbar, label=d$ybarbar) +
  geom_text(y=15, label=d$ssb) -> plot04

plot04
ggsave("../images/plot04.png", width=w, height=h, unit="in")
```

```{r}
#| label: table01

m2 <- aov(y ~ factor(g), data=d)
tidy(m2) |>
  select(term, df, sumsq, meansq) |>
  data.frame() -> table01

table01
```

```{r}
#| label: plot05

x <- seq(0, 6, length=99)
y <- df(x, 5, 28)
data.frame(x, y) |>
	ggplot() +
  aes(x, y) +
	geom_line() +
	labs(
	  caption="Simon, 2024-10-22",
	  x=" ",
	  y=" ") -> plot05

plot05
ggsave("../images/plot05.png", width=w, height=h, unit="in")
```

```{r}
#| label: table02

tidy(m2) |>
  data.frame() -> table02

table02
```

```{r}
#| label: table03

glance(m2) |>
  data.frame() -> table03
```

```{r}
#| label: table04

d |>
	group_by(g) |>
	summarize(y_mean=mean(y))

table04 <- TukeyHSD(m2) 
```


```{r}
#| label: save

save(
  d, 
  table01, 
  table02, 
  table03,
  file="../data/module10.RData")
```



load("../data/module10.RData")
